hookRows.body_you: This year lands on your 5th house, and the main job is joy: romance, creativity, play, and the things you make because you want to. Let yourself be seen enjoying your own life instead of postponing it.
hookRows.body_they: This year lands on their 5th house, and the main job is joy: romance, creativity, play, and the things they make because they want to. The year rewards being seen enjoying their own life instead of postponing it.
hookRows.notes: Profection-year per-person line (Friends Circle per-person sections + You page). Dual-voice authored separately.

hookRows.body_you: This year lands on your 6th house, where the daily details run the show: your work, physical health, habits, and the maintenance you've been putting off. This isn't about massive leaps; small, consistent tweaks made now pay off for the rest of the 12-year cycle.

hookRows.body_you: This year lands on your 7th house, and partnership takes the lead: romantic, business, or the one-to-one friendships that work like either. The people across the table are this year's teachers, in commitment and in contrast.

hookRows.body_you: This year lands on your 9th house, and the horizon stretches: travel, study, belief, and the questions that do not fit in a week. Chase what you actually want to understand. The year funds curiosity.

hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: You and {{holder1}} know each other well enough to skip half the explanation. That can make the day easy. It can also mean both of you assume an old answer still applies without asking.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} may assume you already know what they want because you used to. Familiarity can save time until one person has changed and the other has not noticed yet.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: An old version of the relationship feels close again. The routines return, the conversations sound familiar, and you know how to be around {{holder1}} without thinking very hard about it.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} may slip back into a role they had with you before. It feels natural because the pattern is already well practiced.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: You and {{holder1}} know how this argument goes. You know who gets louder, who goes quiet, who gives in, and how the night ends. Familiarity can make repetition feel inevitable.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} may respond exactly the way they have before because the role is familiar. The two of you can be halfway through the same argument before anyone notices how predictable it has become.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: An old routine with {{holder1}} feels comfortable because you do not have to think about it. The problem is that you may be agreeing to a version of the relationship you no longer want.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} may fall back into an old routine because it requires less negotiation. What used to work may not fit what {{holder1}} needs now.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: You disagree with {{holder1}} and neither of you has to turn it into a larger problem. You can have a different opinion and still stay in the conversation.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} may be more direct about an opinion they normally soften around you. The difference is easier to handle because it is being said before frustration builds.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: A preference you stopped mentioning comes back up with {{holder1}}. This time you say it before the plan is already made.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} brings up a preference or limit they had stopped mentioning. You find out before the decision is final instead of after {{holder1}} is already unhappy.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: You keep an opinion to yourself because you know {{holder1}} will disagree. Then it comes out as sarcasm, distance, or irritation over something smaller. The disagreement was already there.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} stops mentioning an opinion because the two of you never agree on it. The subject can return later through sarcasm or a sharper response that seems unrelated at first.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: You agree to the restaurant, the plan, or the favor again, even though you already know you do not want it. By the time you finally say no, you are angry that you had to say yes so many times first.
hookRows.body_they: {{holder1}} may finally refuse something they have agreed to several times before. The no can sound stronger because it is carrying every earlier yes they did not mean.
hookRows.note: Supersedes the approved serving row of the same key when flipped; import must treat as supersede-on-approve.

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side is the temper you were told was too much. When you stop apologizing for wanting to win, it converts into courage other people borrow.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side is the temper they were told was too much. When they stop apologizing for wanting to win, it converts into courage other people borrow.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side lives in appetite: food, comfort, money, touch. Shame grew where enjoyment should be, and it heals every time you savor something without justifying it.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side lives in appetite: food, comfort, money, touch. Shame grew where enjoyment should be, and it heals every time they savor something without justifying it.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side is the voice: the questions too sharp, the joke too honest. You learned to soften your words to stay likable, and the medicine is saying the plain version anyway.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side is the voice: the questions too sharp, the joke too honest. They learned to soften their words to stay likable, and the medicine is saying the plain version anyway.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side is the need itself: to be held, to belong, to matter. Somewhere that need got labeled clingy, so you feed everyone else first. Letting yourself be taken care of is the repair.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side is the need itself: to be held, to belong, to matter. Somewhere that need got labeled clingy, so they feed everyone else first. Letting themselves be taken care of is the repair.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side wants the spotlight it was shamed out of. The cure is not humility; you have plenty. It is taking up the space on purpose and letting the room adjust.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side wants the spotlight it was shamed out of. The cure is not humility; they have plenty. It is taking up the space on purpose and letting the room adjust.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side hides inside the standards: the mess you will not show, the flaw you will not admit. Perfection was the deal you made to be safe. It breaks in small public ways, on purpose.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side hides inside the standards: the mess they will not show, the flaw they will not admit. Perfection was the deal they made to be safe. It breaks in small public ways, on purpose.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side is the no you swallow to keep things pleasant. Every unfought fight is stored, not gone. Disagreeing out loud, kindly, is how the charge drains.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side is the no they swallow to keep things pleasant. Every unfought fight is stored, not gone. Disagreeing out loud, kindly, is how the charge drains.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side runs deep and knows it: desire, jealousy, the will to keep a secret. You control it because you fear it. It settles when you tell the truth about wanting what you want.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side runs deep and knows it: desire, jealousy, the will to keep a secret. They control it because they fear it. It settles when they tell the truth about wanting what they want.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side is the belief you are not supposed to say in polite company. You dilute your convictions to stay easygoing. Standing behind one of them, undiluted, is the medicine.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side is the belief they are not supposed to say in polite company. They dilute their convictions to stay easygoing. Standing behind one of them, undiluted, is the medicine.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side is ambition without the apology: wanting the position, the money, the authority. Someone taught you that hunger is ugly. It is fuel for the climb.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side is ambition without the apology: wanting the position, the money, the authority. Someone taught them that hunger is ugly. It is fuel for the climb.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side is the strangeness you sanded down to function in groups. The opinions you keep offline are the ones the group actually needs. Being the odd one on purpose is the point.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side is the strangeness they sanded down to function in groups. The opinions they keep offline are the ones the group actually needs. Being the odd one on purpose is the point.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Your untamed side dissolved into everyone else's feelings a long time ago. Not knowing where you end and other people begin was safer than having edges. The repair is a boundary that holds even when someone cries.
hookRows.body_they: Their untamed side dissolved into everyone else's feelings a long time ago. Not knowing where they ended and other people began was safer than having edges. The repair is a boundary that holds even when someone cries.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Here it sits right on the surface: people meet the untamed part first and react to it. Stop managing their reaction; it filters for you.
hookRows.body_they: Here it sits right on the surface: people meet the untamed part first and react to it. It filters people, which is the point.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Money and worth carry the charge. Undercharging and overgiving are the old survival moves; asking full price is the reclamation.
hookRows.body_they: Money and worth carry the charge. Undercharging and overgiving are the old survival moves; asking full price is the reclamation.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It speaks. The texts you delete unsent, the comment you bite back: that is where the wildness lives. Say more of it.
hookRows.body_they: It speaks. The texts they delete unsent, the comment they bite back: that is where the wildness lives, and more of it wants out.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: The exile started at home, in what the family refused to discuss. Making your own home a place where nothing is unsayable is the repair.
hookRows.body_they: The exile started at home, in what the family refused to discuss. Making their own home a place where nothing is unsayable is the repair.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It wants to make things and be seen making them. The shamed creativity did not die; date it again, badly and in public.
hookRows.body_they: It wants to make things and be seen making them. The shamed creativity did not die; it revives the moment they make things badly and in public again.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It shows up at work as the tasks you resent and the help you will not ask for. Refusing the martyr role is the medicine.
hookRows.body_they: It shows up at work as the tasks they resent and the help they will not ask for. Refusing the martyr role is the medicine.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It gets projected onto partners: you pick people who act out the boldness you disown. Take the role back and the relationships calm down.
hookRows.body_they: It gets projected onto partners: they pick people who act out the boldness they disown. When they take the role back, the relationships calm down.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It lives in the merged places: sex, shared money, secrets. Power games start where honesty stopped. Go first.
hookRows.body_they: It lives in the merged places: sex, shared money, secrets. Power games start where honesty stopped, and honesty has to go first.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It argues with the doctrine you were raised on. The heresy you keep private is usually your actual belief. Study it instead of suppressing it.
hookRows.body_they: It argues with the doctrine they were raised on. The heresy they keep private is usually their actual belief. Studied instead of suppressed, it settles.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It is visible at the top: the ambition or the scandal you fear being known for. Build the reputation on the real version; it holds better.
hookRows.body_they: It is visible at the top: the ambition or the scandal they fear being known for. A reputation built on the real version holds better.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: Groups trigger it: the fear of being cast out for the true opinion. The right room wants the uncensored you. Find that room.
hookRows.body_they: Groups trigger it: the fear of being cast out for the true opinion. The right room wants the uncensored version of them.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: It works backstage, in dreams, habits, and the anger with no name. Give it language, in therapy or on the page, before it books its own appointments.
hookRows.body_they: It works backstage, in dreams, habits, and the anger with no name. Given language, in therapy or on the page, it stops booking its own appointments.
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_you: your untamed side and what it refuses
hookRows.body_they: their untamed side and what it refuses
hookRows.notes: Black Moon Lilith rows (full-surface extension, chat 2026-07-22).

hookRows.body_they: With {{signTitle}} ruling their {{houseOrdinal}}, {{rulerRef}} is driving things this year. Every time {{rulerRef}} shifts signs, stations, or forms an aspect in the sky, their life shifts with it. Its key dates tend to mark their turning points.

hookRows.body_they: With Cancer ruling their {{houseOrdinal}}, the Moon is driving things this year. The Moon moves fast, so the year runs in waves: every New Moon, Full Moon, and eclipse opens a new scene. The lunations tend to mark their turning points.
